title: Create course content aligned with the curriculum. (success)
story: Reference run: right tools, answer fully supported by what was read.
description: Find the approved curriculum and learning objectives, open the relevant source materials, then create content from the opened sources only.
expected_reference: A short cell division module for BIO101 Unit 3 that is aligned to objectives LO-3.1 to LO-3.4 from approved curriculum CUR-BIO101-2024B. It should be built only from SRC-BIO101-U3-01 and cover four topics: the cell cycle phases (G1, S, G2, M), the mitosis stages in order, a comparison of mitosis and meiosis, and the role of the G1, G2 and spindle checkpoints in preventing tumours. It should also note the 6-hour unit allocation.
